experiment: V12 raw-online equal-device federated multi-dataset holdout

provenance.not_prospective_reason: PRONOSTIA and other dataset outcomes were examined in earlier experiments before this V12 split was designed.
provenance.claim_boundary: This is not untouched prospective confirmation and must not be described as such. HIT is fixed-fault transfer, not run-to-failure early warning.

client_definition: one physical bearing or documented recording unit equals exactly one federated client
test_split_rationale: Three held-out units per dataset, except LDM-UPB where both available units are held out. XJTU and PRONOSTIA contribute one unit per operating-condition family; IMS contributes one known failing bearing per run. HIT contributes its three fixed-fault files and is evaluated separately.

raw_online_contract.node_history_scope: past local feature vectors and model state only
raw_online_contract.normalizer: local median/MAD fit after the first 20 observed acquisitions and then frozen
raw_online_contract.federated_weighting: exactly 1/40 per source device per server round, independent of sample count and dataset
raw_online_contract.test_release: held-out raw streams are not opened until the source model and alarm policy lock exists

local_feature_schema.per_channel: 12 signed-log time features plus 16 normalized-frequency log-power bands and four spectral-shape features
local_feature_schema.channel_aggregation: 32 channel means, 32 channel standard deviations, 32 channel extrema by absolute magnitude, plus four cross-channel descriptors
local_feature_schema.sampling_rate_dependency: frequency bins are normalized to Nyquist, so no target sampling rate is supplied to the model
local_feature_schema.raw_axes: all available vibration axes for the physical bearing; metadata and labels are excluded

federated_training.training_data: each source node's first 20 locally normalized commissioning observations only
federated_training.policy_development: source-client histories only; held-out labels and streams forbidden

evaluation_proxies.valid_early_window: at or after 60% and before 90% of the stored run
evaluation_proxies.note: Normalized-life zones are evaluation proxies, not verified physical degradation-onset labels.
evaluation_proxies.hit: Report fixed-fault discrimination separately; no warning lead-time or premature-alarm claim.

separate_tables: all 17 requested units with task caveat
